established_bounds: The API host reached and reserved the exclusive OUT directory, constructed an attempt object, and wrote a 1991-byte parseable JSON staging file. The staged source/admission/interpreter hash labels match the reviewed candidate.

The public attempt.json is absent; only attempt.json.writing exists under OUT. There is no host result, worker stream, worker readiness, protocol, stage directory, fixture timing, runner timing or control verdict.

In the pinned source, save(attempt.json) occurs before creation of the watchdog, before the guarded Job creation, and before worker Popen. A normal return from save would publish attempt.json and remove its staging name. The observed state and generic caught-exception console therefore locate this abort at the attempt-publication boundary before Job/worker/pair execution, assuming no unrecorded external deletion.

The top-level Exception handler only writes detailed preflight-error evidence when OUT does not exist. OUT already existed, so the precise exception was discarded and only generic BLOCKED was printed.
The controller receipt records return code 1 and 2.219 seconds. This is an aborted host invocation, not a fixture readiness timeout or lifecycle control failure.
Initial resource labels in the staged attempt exceed the original floors. No ownership, cancellation, sentinel, settlement or native readiness behavior was exercised.
unknowns: Exact exception type, message, traceback and native error code are unavailable. No WinError 5 claim is supported.

No new descendant startup, instrumentation-causality or deadline-adequacy conclusion follows because the fixture pair did not run.
